p: Mare Street is Hackney's main road, and this stretch near Hackney Central puts you within a few minutes of some of the borough's best-loved spots.

The Hackney Empire, the grand Victorian variety theatre famous for its panto, is just along the street, next to the striking Art Deco town hall. London Fields and Broadway Market, with its Saturday food stalls, are a short walk south, and Sutton House, a Tudor house run by the National Trust, is tucked away nearby too. Admiral itself is an 18+ adult gaming centre, so the kids won't be coming in. Hackney is a fantastic place to eat, from Vietnamese on Mare Street to old-school pie and mash.
